speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened; can you tell me exactly what happens during those moments and if you recall any dreams?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmare Disorder.

I have reviewed your history of waking up frightened with recall of the event and no confusion, which distinguishes this from sleep terrors. Given the chronic nature over two months, have you noticed any recent stressors, such as changes at school or family dynamics?
